verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a payments and banking service, and such a product could plausibly offer natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents REST APIs, embedded flows and an llms.txt file. These are developer building blocks for agents or LLMs, not a first-party way to operate the product with natural-language commands, and no assistant, chat interface or natural-language command feature is shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
